assertion: COMPANY: direct qualifying share owner is identified from supported evidence.
deferredBehavior: Qualification and identification require Gate 2 reasoning; S01 protects the direct COMPANY input shape only.

assertion: LLP: qualifying rights to surplus assets are evaluated using LLP semantics.
deferredBehavior: Qualification and evaluation require Gate 2 reasoning; S02 protects LLP surplus-asset semantics only.

assertion: Corporate holder creates an InformationNeed until ultimate natural persons are resolved.
deferredBehavior: Creating an InformationNeed is Gate 2 behavior; S05 and S11 protect unresolved corporate-layer inputs.

assertion: Percentage chains multiply deterministically.
deferredBehavior: S03 preserves the percentage chain; multiplication remains Gate 2 reasoning.

assertion: Independent qualifying paths aggregate.
deferredBehavior: S04 preserves independent paths; aggregation remains Gate 2 reasoning.

assertion: Ranges remain ranges/min-max rather than being silently converted to exact percentages.
deferredBehavior: S10 preserves range bounds and endpoints; range reasoning remains Gate 2.

assertion: Cycles cannot silently produce a numeric answer.
deferredBehavior: S18 preserves directed cycle facts; cycle detection and non-numeric reasoning remain Gate 2.

assertion: COMPANY: qualifying board-majority appointment right produces controller_appointment.
deferredBehavior: Qualification and controller role projection require Gate 2; S15 protects COMPANY appointment-right inputs.

assertion: LLP: qualifying majority-management appointment right produces controller_appointment.
deferredBehavior: Qualification and controller role projection require Gate 2; S15 protects LLP management-right inputs.

assertion: Risk checkpoint HIGH invalidates attestation-only closure and produces documentary gap without bespoke screen logic.
deferredBehavior: P08 preserves high-risk and negative-attestation inputs; closure and gap generation remain Gate 2.

assertion: Positive registry control fact may create a candidate claim.
deferredBehavior: Candidate-claim creation is Gate 2 behavior; P02 protects positive PSC candidate inputs.

assertion: Absence of PSC condition-4 data does not negatively resolve the requirement.
deferredBehavior: Negative requirement resolution is Gate 2 behavior; P02 and S06 protect absence/NO_DATA inputs.

assertion: Ambiguous veto/decision rights route to REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than automatic UBO determination.
deferredBehavior: REVIEW_REQUIRED routing is Gate 2 behavior; S16 preserves an ambiguous control candidate.

assertion: Customer declaration alone cannot resolve R08.
deferredBehavior: P01 separates declaration and independent evidence; sufficiency remains Gate 2.

assertion: Numeric evidence strength alone cannot bypass independent-source requirement.
deferredBehavior: P01 supplies source-type inputs; evidence sufficiency remains Gate 2.

assertion: Companies House PSC information may corroborate but must not automatically become final UBO conclusion.
deferredBehavior: P01 and P02 preserve corroborative PSC inputs; final-conclusion semantics remain Gate 2.

assertion: Material missing PSC may create reportable discrepancy workflow.
deferredBehavior: P07 preserves comparison inputs; reportable-discrepancy workflow requires later integration.

assertion: Difference caused only by PSC-vs-MLR definition mismatch is not automatically reportable.
deferredBehavior: P07 preserves PSC and MLR comparison bases; definition-mismatch determination remains Gate 2.

assertion: Non-material discrepancy records rationale without automatically invoking report workflow.
deferredBehavior: P07 preserves differing assertions; materiality and rationale generation remain Gate 2.

assertion: Fallback cannot activate merely because DiscoveryService returned NO_DATA.
deferredBehavior: S06 and P03 separate NO_DATA from fallback inputs; fallback determination remains Gate 2.

assertion: Fallback cannot activate when required measures were not actually completed.
deferredBehavior: P03 records incomplete measures; fallback-precondition evaluation remains Gate 2.

assertion: Snapshot records measures taken and reason fallback was permitted.
deferredBehavior: P03 preserves measures-taken inputs; decision snapshot production remains Gate 2.
